page_title: ARS 2-1 EVE | Arsenal v Everton 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Substitution. Abdoulaye Doucoure did his best and is replaced by Beto (Everton).
90+2' Michael Oliver sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+1' Wait! Referee Michael Oliver has indicated he is going to review the Arsenal goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' 2 - 1 Goal! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 2:1.
87' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
87' Arsenal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
83' Jordan Pickford (Everton) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
83' Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the bar!
80' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
78' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) replacing Leandro Trossard.
77' 6:1 – the corner kicks stats.
75' Substitution. Chermiti (Everton) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dominic Calvert-Lewin walks off.
73' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) has tested the patience of referee Michael Oliver and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
72' The attendance is 60312.
69' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) replaces Thomas Partey.
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) coming on for Ben White.
68' 64:36 – the latest ball possession ratio.
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Declan Rice (Arsenal) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the corner but it's cleared.

65' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Arsenal.
63' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
61' Ben White (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
59' We are about to witness a subsitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) for Gabriel.
58' Looks like Gabriel (Arsenal) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
54' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
53' The statistic for corner kicks – 3:1.
50' James Tarkowski (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.
48' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Martin Odegaard picks out Thomas Partey (Arsenal), who drives a shot just over the crossbar from the edge of the box.
45+5' The Arsenal players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
45+3' James Tarkowski (Everton) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+2' Arsenal concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.

43' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Martin Odegaard plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
43' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:4.
42' Declan Rice (Arsenal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
40' 0 - 1 Goal! The free-kick is fired in by Idrissa Gueye (Everton) and the ball inadvertently flicks off a defender and spins into the net, leaving David Raya stranded. 0:1.
39' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Thomas Partey (Arsenal) for his blatant foul.
38' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
33' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
32' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
32' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
28' Amadou Onana (Everton) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
27' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Some patient build-up play from Everton as they look to unlock the defence.
23' A player from Arsenal commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
22' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner.
22' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
20' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
18' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Jordan Pickford.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 76:24.
14' Declan Rice (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
12' Declan Rice (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
8' David Raya leaps to intercept the corner kick from Dwight McNeil (Everton).
5' Arsenal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
5' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Arsenal.
3' Arsenal are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Arsenal will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Michael Oliver.
